text:
maggie: Quick sync — we need to align on how we signal backpressure/fallback to clients. Right now some routes return 429, others 503, and the console shows different hints. Can we standardize a surface that includes a machine-readable hint + a short human message?

sanjay: +1. Propose semantics: 429 = client quota exceeded, 503 = transient overload/backpressure. Include a structured body hint like `{ \"code\": \"BACKPRESSURE\", \"retry_after_ms\": 500, \"fallback\": \"gpt-small\" }` so SDKs can act.

elaine: I strongly prefer a single JSON schema called `error_hint` in the response body. Clients often strip headers. Example body snippet we should standardize: 

```
{"error": "service_unavailable", "error_hint": {"kind": "backpressure", "retry_after_ms": 500, "fallback": "gpt-small", "note": "reduced throughput"}}
```

jordan: We must not blur quota semantics — keep 429 for rate/quota. 503 for overload/backpressure. Hints can be in a header for quick routing, e.g. `X-Redwood-Error-Hint: fallback=gpt-small;retry=500ms`, but agree body-first is safer.

infra-bot: FYI deploy: canary for /v2/stream will include hint headers as experiment (canary id=12).

sanjay: Telemetry needs: `signal_type` (quota|backpressure|fallback), `route_id`, and `hint_payload` (sparse). Sample traces at 1% ingest, but aggregate counts at 100% to console. Avoid logging full request bodies.

maggie: Console UX asks: show explicit \"fallback reason\" in request details, and a small timeline that shows when fallback happened + latency delta. Also expose a per-route breakdown of backpressure events.

elaine: One real issue: proxies/clients may strip or normalize headers. So we must put the canonical hint in the JSON body (`error_hint`) and treat headers as convenience. Header-only is brittle.

jordan: Action items: (1) spec JSON schema for `error_hint` (owner: @elaine), (2) server: emit `X-Redwood-Error-Hint` + body `error_hint` when applicable (owner: @sanjay), (3) console: surface fallback timeline / model delta (owner: @maggie), (4) telemetry: add metric `backpressure.events` and span tag `rb.hint` (owner: @jordan).

maggie: 👍 I'll put the RFC on the board and include sample SDK behavior (auto-fallback + backoff). @deploy-bot please run a canary and capture presence of both header+body across requests.

deploy-bot: Canary started: /v2/stream canary-12. Sampled 500 reqs so far: 8 requests show both header+body, 42 show body-only (proxy stripped headers), remainder header-only or no hint.

maggie: Ok — consensus: body-first, header as fast path. Thanks all, I'll file follow-ups and start the spec draft.
